title: Pioneering Sustainable Menstrual Care in Nigeria
excerpt: How Green AVIC is empowering women and protecting ecosystems through 100% biodegradable, plastic-free period products.
body:
Our Commitment to Women and the Planet

Every year, millions of conventional plastic sanitary pads end up in landfills and oceans, taking centuries to decompose while exposing women's skin to harsh synthetic chemicals. At Green AVIC, we believe comfort, health, and environmental sustainability should go hand-in-hand.

Why Plant-Based Period Care Matters

Our Fearless range is crafted from natural, breathable plant fibers that biodegrade safely. By combining dermatologically tested hypoallergenic materials with high-absorbency natural cellulose, we offer complete leak protection and supreme peace of mind.

Comfort for your body, care for the earth.

Join us on our journey to eliminate menstrual poverty, educate young girls on reproductive wellness, and foster eco-conscious living across our communities.
